decision: Defer a component-normalization routing comparison. The inspected sources establish a diagnostic pad-partition observer, not one still-justified, failure-linked ordinary-board routing intervention.
scope: Read-only specified component sources, directly linked source/control reviews, actual-controls summary and retained Universal300 summary. No imports, tests, Native/JVM, network, broader source search or source edits. Only this new decision record is written.
completed_not_to_repeat: Six actual chain/chain-cut/zone-islands/layer-gap/via-bridge/physical-short cases and pure readback already qualified diagnostic partition behavior.
Stale board/rules/refill, wrong wrapper/worker and actual post-census SIGINT controls already completed; failed setup/oversize attempts remain recorded.

Actual retained22-pad thermal counterexample has all six same-net groups connected despite zero opens, one starved_thermal and ten warnings. Connectivity partition equivalence cannot repair or waive that Native failure.

concrete_blocker.mechanism_gap: normalize.py validates complete symmetric/transitive same-net PAD UUID partitions. worker.py only observes a caller-refilled board, never saves it, explicitly leaves refill semantics to its caller and always keeps routing_accepted/production_admitted false. controls.py invokes no engine or routing normalization consumer.
concrete_blocker.missing_failure_link: The inspected actual evidence does not identify an ordinary supported baseline failure caused specifically by an incorrect engine representation of these pad components. The positive partition controls demonstrate observation capability; they do not show a missed completion opportunity. The thermal counterexample establishes an independent requirement the observer cannot satisfy.
concrete_blocker.scope_gap: The observer is limited to two outer copper layers,256pads,128source nets and ordinary pads. Existing whole-net helpers still cannot express per-component representatives and retain their64-net limit. Raising a cap alone would neither qualify transport nor close the causal gap.
concrete_blocker.unresolved_prerequisite: Before any routing comparison, identify a retained immutable task within the current declared scope whose fresh source-bound/refilled complete pad partitions demonstrably disagree with the actual engine connection representation, and specify a source/net/terminal/class/layer/protected-copper preserving transport change that addresses that exact discrepancy. No such qualified intervention is established by these files.

baseline_classification.faithful_adapter_fix: If a later mismatch proves the adapter discards existing electrical connectivity, its correction belongs in B1 and competent B2 under the same constraints and total budget.
baseline_classification.C_beyond_B2: A partition observer or faithful transport repair alone is not a C strategy gain. A separate frozen intervention and measured improvement over corrected/tuned B2 would still be required.

retained_failure_context: Universal300 records one remaining open plus one starved thermal in corrected/C-incumbent outcomes and no accepted result. Its historical next-recovery paragraph is not treated as a current unexecuted task: the lead's current failure audit already deferred PAW/Universal retries. No completed recovery/control or broad MAX64 extension is proposed.
next_action: No Native, engine or source work authorized by this audit recommendation. Keep the observer diagnostic-only and defer until the stated input-specific representation mismatch and safe transport contract exist.
limitations: This bounded audit is not an exhaustive proof that component routing can never help. Historical numerical evidence was read as retained observations, not rerun or relabelled current018 qualification. No new supported family, completion gain, holdout, electrical/physical or human-review claim.
